entities.title: Ship types
entities.summary: The type numbers and the rule stats of every ship and object.
entities.purpose: Declares the type numbers several rules compare (1 to 13, and 128 to 130 for the planets and the sun) and each type's stats from GDD § 5.5: canisters, hit size, bounty, energy, speed, laser and missiles.
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
Presentation-only fields (gun point, explosion points, model) live in the art, not here.
